selection: All366 cross-split representatives from the792 remaining component-pair candidates; first36 prioritized by aligned64-pixel MAE, then the remaining330 contact-sheet reviews.
test_protocol: Raw image files were inspected only for integrity/grouping, without model predictions, metrics or mistakes. These images do not guide architecture, augmentation, thresholds or checkpoint selection.
limitations: Not exhaustive biological identity or annotation verification. Different images can share an undocumented plant or capture session; crops/edits outside the similarity screen can remain.
remaining_scope: The426 remaining listed candidates are within splits; this review does not exhaust every possible related image outside the candidate screen.

raw_feature_checks.control_purpose: Crop/resize/JPEG correspondence software only; not additional training/evaluation evidence.
raw_feature_checks.limitations: Sparse/collinear/background correspondences are not enough for identity. Failed correspondence does not prove no related plant, source photo crop or capture session.

case_list_reconstruction: Both helpers reconstruct the exact792 ordered cases from the frozen release manifest and candidate metadata, and reject an existing list with different values/order.
